cases.sentence: Была уже половина ___, а Сергей Иванович только теперь собрался выехать из Москвы.
cases.explain: «жаркого лета» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Almost two months had passed. The hot summer was half over, but Sergey Ivanovitch was only just preparing to leave Moscow.

cases.sentence: Уже с год назад была кончена его книга, плод ___, озаглавленная: – «Опыт обзора основ и форм государственности в Европе и в России».
cases.explain: «шестилетнего труда» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Sergey Ivanovitch’s life had not been uneventful during this time. A year ago he had finished his book, the fruit of six years’ labor, Sketch of a Survey of the Principles and Forms of Government in Europe and Russia. Several sections of this book and its introduction had appeared in periodical publications, and other parts had been read by Sergey Ivanovitch to persons of his circle, so that the leading ideas of the work could not be completely novel to the public. But still Sergey Ivanovitch had expected that on its appearance his book would be sure to make a serious impression on society, and if it did not cause a revolution in social science it would, at any rate, make a great stir in the scientific world.

cases.sentence: Книга эта после ___ была издана в прошлом году и разослана книгопродавцам.
cases.explain: «тщательной отделки» — after the preposition «после», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: After the most conscientious revision the book had last year been published, and had been distributed among the booksellers.

cases.sentence: Наконец на ___ в серьезном журнале появилась критическая статья.
cases.explain: «третий месяц» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: At last in the third month a critical article appeared in a serious review. Sergey Ivanovitch knew the author of the article. He had met him once at Golubtsov’s.

cases.sentence: Несмотря на совершенное презрение свое к автору, Сергей Иванович с ___ приступил к чтению статьи.
cases.explain: «совершенным уважением» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: In spite of his absolute contempt for the author, it was with complete respect that Sergey Ivanovitch set about reading the article. The article was awful.

cases.sentence: И, вспомнив, как он при встрече поправил этого ___ в выказывавшем его невежество слове, Сергей Иванович нашел объяснение смысла статьи.
cases.explain: «молодого человека» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: And remembering that when they met he had corrected the young man about something he had said that betrayed ignorance, Sergey Ivanovitch found the clue to explain the article.

cases.sentence: В среде людей, к которым принадлежал Сергей Иванович, в это время ни о чем другом не говорили и не писали, как о ___ и сербской войне.
cases.explain: «славянском вопросе» — after the preposition «о», for location or topic.
cases.translation: In the circle to which Sergey Ivanovitch belonged, nothing was talked of or written about just now but the Serbian War. Everything that the idle crowd usually does to kill time was done now for the benefit of the Slavonic States. Balls, concerts, dinners, matchboxes, ladies’ dresses, beer, restaurants—everything testified to sympathy with the Slavonic peoples.

cases.sentence: Балы, концерты, обеды, спичи, ___, пиво, трактиры – все свидетельствовало о сочувствии к славянам.
cases.explain: «дамские наряды» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: In the circle to which Sergey Ivanovitch belonged, nothing was talked of or written about just now but the Serbian War. Everything that the idle crowd usually does to kill time was done now for the benefit of the Slavonic States. Balls, concerts, dinners, matchboxes, ladies’ dresses, beer, restaurants—everything testified to sympathy with the Slavonic peoples.

cases.sentence: ___ получила выражение, как говорил Сергей Иванович.
cases.explain: «Народная душа» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: But in this there was another aspect that rejoiced Sergey Ivanovitch. That was the manifestation of public opinion. The public had definitely expressed its desire. The soul of the people had, as Sergey Ivanovitch said, found expression. And the more he worked in this cause, the more incontestable it seemed to him that it was a cause destined to assume vast dimensions, to create an epoch.

cases.sentence: И чем более он занимался этим делом, тем очевиднее ему казалось, что это было дело, долженствующее получить ___, составить эпоху.
cases.explain: «громадные размеры» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: But in this there was another aspect that rejoiced Sergey Ivanovitch. That was the manifestation of public opinion. The public had definitely expressed its desire. The soul of the people had, as Sergey Ivanovitch said, found expression. And the more he worked in this cause, the more incontestable it seemed to him that it was a cause destined to assume vast dimensions, to create an epoch.
